dek: A three-month surge in humanoid robot shipments has produced a fast-growing third-party repair and training job in China. Trainees like Zhao Xin in Ordos now earn about six thousand yuan a month disassembling knee joints and reading App error codes, with the Unitree Go2 the most common patient.
